hubAbout.statusOpen: Open country: members who live there can post in this hub. Every DIASPORALE member can read it, wherever they live.
hubAbout.statusNotOpen: Not open yet: every member can read this hub. Those who live there can post for the whole diaspora; posting in this hub waits for the country to open.
hubAbout.openingRule: A country is opened by the platform administration. The network's rule is to open it with {{relays}} relay associations and {{moderators}} moderator; the app does not check this condition on its own yet.
hubAbout.reportReminder: A post, comment or page that breaks the rules? Open its menu and choose “Report”: the network's moderation team reviews it, and its author does not know who reported it.
hubAbout.visibleMembers: Visible members: those who chose to appear in the directory.
